''See also: [[White Sun Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The White Sun is the primary symbol of the [[Luminian Order]], a group consisting of silver-armored knights and white-clad [[Pilgrims]]. It is represented by various forms, including a silver medallion featuring a white diamond or sun emblem, which serves as a powerful Beacon for those who possess it. These medallions can act as focuses for [[Intent]], capable of emitting blinding light to destroy enemies or providing a sense of safety and peace. The symbol is also prominently displayed on red banners at [[Hightower]], the fortified headquarters of the [[Luminian Order]]. This location features a massive [[stone tower]] topped with a large glass orb that functions as a blazing white lantern, acting as a second sun for the guild. Beyond its role as a religious or organizational icon representing the [[Unknown God]], the White Sun is associated with themes of protection and righteousness, and it can be amplified to provide defensive support for entire regions.}}
